---
title: Fava Bean Cream with Pecorino
id: MAR-0025
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 60
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 250 g dried fava beans
- 150 g grated Pecorino Romano
- 5 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- to taste salt and pepper
## Method
1. Rinse the fava beans, put them in a pot, cover them generously with water, cook for about 30-40 minutes from the start of boiling, and salt.
2. At the end of cooking, remove any excess water and quickly stir the fava beans with a wooden spoon to break them up.
3. Heat the oil, add the fava bean cream, stir, and after 2 minutes add the Pecorino.
4. Cook for another 2 minutes and turn off the heat.
5. Adjust salt, pepper generously, and serve the cream hot.
